conversation.speaker: ai_agent

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: For example, superposition is like a spinning coin that is both heads and tails until it lands, and entanglement is like having two linked coins that always land on the same side, no matter how far apart they are. These phenomena allow quantum computers to explore many solutions simultaneously.
